earth-full-size.alt: a ball of liquid rock, glowing orange-red, brighter yellow-white cracks, a few darker cooling crusts floating on it

great-oxidation-begins.alt: smooth and featureless like Titan, thick orange-tan haze, faint soft banding, no continents or oceans visible

snowball-earth.alt: ice pole to pole, pale blue-grey fracture lines like cracked porcelain, a few small bare rock patches near the middle

archaeopteryx.alt: a raven-sized dinosaur-like animal with sharp teeth, a long bony tail, and feathered wings

stromatolites.alt: a rounded, layered mound of banded rock, like a stack of thin stone plates or a cross-section of a cabbage

dimetrodon.alt: a lizard-like animal with a tall sail of skin down its back, held up by long spines

charnia.alt: a frond like a fern or chestnut leaf, branching ridges repeating as smaller copies of themselves down its length, rooted to the seabed by a small disc

cooksonia.alt: a few centimetres of forking, leafless green stems, splitting into two even branches again and again, with small rounded capsules at the branch tips

coal-forests.alt: a giant dragonfly, long segmented body, two pairs of long net-veined wings held flat to the sides
